mapper.select: SELECT execution_facts.task_id AS taskId, execution_facts.total_group_count AS totalGroupCount, execution_facts.completed_group_count AS completedGroupCount, execution_facts.failed_group_count AS failedGroupCount, execution_facts.abandoned_group_count AS abandonedGroupCount, execution_facts.executing_group_count AS executingGroupCount, execution_facts.waiting_group_count AS waitingGroupCount, execution_facts.manager_shortage_group_count AS managerShortageGroupCount, execution_facts.puller_shortage_group_count AS pullerShortageGroupCount, execution_facts.station_shortage_group_count AS stationShortageGroupCount, COALESCE(material_facts.total_member_count, 0) AS totalMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.unconsumed_member_count, 0) AS unconsumedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.submitted_member_count, 0) AS submittedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.successful_member_count, 0) AS successfulMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.failed_member_count, 0) AS failedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.unknown_member_count, 0) AS unknownMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.canceled_member_count, 0) AS canceledMemberCount, COALESCE(account_facts.available_puller_count, 0) AS availablePullerCount, execution_facts.last_executed_at AS lastExecutedAt FROM ( SELECT execution_row.task_id, COUNT(*) AS total_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.completed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.failed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.abandoned} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandoned_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.executing} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS executing_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status IN (#{criteria.execution.waitStart}, #{criteria.execution.waitResource}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.waitResource} AND execution_row.wait_resource_type = #{criteria.execution.managerResource} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manager_shortage_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.waitResource} AND execution_row.wait_resource_type = #{criteria.execution.pullerResource} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS puller_shortage_group_count, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_row.execution_status = #{criteria.execution.waitResource} AND execution_row.wait_resource_type = #{criteria.execution.stationResource} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS station_shortage_group_count, MAX(execution_row.last_business_executed_at) AS last_executed_at FROM pull_task_group_execution execution_row WHERE execution_row.task_id IN AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_group_execution newer_execution WHERE newer_execution.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id AND newer_execution.task_id = execution_row.task_id AND newer_execution.seq = execution_row.seq AND newer_execution.attempt_no > execution_row.attempt_no ) GROUP BY execution_row.task_id ) execution_facts LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_execution.task_id, COUNT(*) AS total_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.unconsumed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconsumed_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.submitted} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submitted_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.success} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.failed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.unknown} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.canceled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_member_count FROM pull_task_material_member material_row JOIN pull_task_group_execution material_execution ON material_execution.id = material_row.group_execution_id AND material_execution.tenant_id = material_row.tenant_id WHERE material_execution.task_id IN AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_group_execution newer_execution WHERE newer_execution.tenant_id = material_execution.tenant_id AND newer_execution.task_id = material_execution.task_id AND newer_execution.seq = material_execution.seq AND newer_execution.attempt_no > material_execution.attempt_no ) GROUP BY material_execution.task_id ) material_facts ON material_facts.task_id = execution_facts.task_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_row.task_id, COUNT(*) AS available_puller_count FROM pull_task_group_account account_row WHERE account_row.task_id IN AND account_row.role_type = #{criteria.account.pullerRole} AND account_row.availability_status = #{criteria.account.available} AND account_row.released_at IS NULL GROUP BY account_row.task_id ) account_facts ON account_facts.task_id = execution_facts.task_id ORDER BY execution_facts.task_id DESC

SELECT execution_row.id AS execution_id, task_row.status AS task_status, wave_row.id AS wave_id, wave_row.wave_no, wave_row.wave_status, wave_row.planned_call_count, wave_row.next_dispatch_at, call_row.id AS call_id, call_row.wave_call_seq, call_row.call_status, call_row.planned_material_count, call_row.command_id, call_row.submitted_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pull_task_material_member material_row WHERE material_row.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id AND material_row.group_execution_id = execution_row.id AND material_row.pull_call_id = call_row.id AND material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.unconsumedMaterial}) AS bound_material_count, (SELECT MIN(action_row.submitted_at) FROM pull_task_account_action action_row WHERE action_row.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id AND action_row.group_execution_id = execution_row.id AND action_row.action_status = #{criteria.submittedAction} AND action_row.action_type NOT IN #{actionType}) AS action_submitted_at FROM pull_task_group_execution execution_row JOIN pull_task task_row ON task_row.id = execution_row.task_id AND task_row.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id LEFT JOIN pull_task_pull_wave wave_row ON wave_row.id = execution_row.active_pull_wave_id AND wave_row.group_execution_id = execution_row.id AND wave_row.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id AND wave_row.wave_status IN #{waveStatus} LEFT JOIN pull_task_pull_call call_row ON call_row.id = ( SELECT candidate.id FROM pull_task_pull_call candidate WHERE candidate.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id AND candidate.group_execution_id = execution_row.id AND candidate.pull_wave_id = wave_row.id AND candidate.call_status IN (#{criteria.plannedCall}, #{criteria.submittedCall}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN candidate.call_status = #{criteria.submittedCall} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, candidate.wave_call_seq ASC, candidate.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AND call_row.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id WHERE execution_row.id IN AND task_row.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY execution_row.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pull_task_group_execution execution_row WHERE
SELECT execution_row.* FROM pull_task_group_execution execution_row WHERE ORDER BY execution_row.seq ASC, execution_row.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT execution_row.id AS executionId, COALESCE(material_facts.total_member_count, 0) AS totalMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.unconsumed_member_count, 0) AS unconsumedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.submitted_member_count, 0) AS submittedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.successful_member_count, 0) AS successfulMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.failed_member_count, 0) AS failedMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.unknown_member_count, 0) AS unknownMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.canceled_member_count, 0) AS canceledMemberCount, COALESCE(material_facts.retry_pending_count, 0) AS retryPendingCount, material_facts.last_successful_at AS lastSuccessfulAt, COALESCE(attempt_facts.submitted_attempt_count, 0) AS submittedAttemptCount, COALESCE(attempt_facts.unconfirmed_attempt_count, 0) AS unconfirmedAttemptCount, setting_row.required_manager_count AS requiredManagerCount, setting_row.puller_count_per_group AS plannedPullerCount, setting_row.station_count_per_call AS plannedStationCount, COALESCE(account_facts.current_manager_count, 0) AS currentManagerCount, COALESCE(account_facts.current_puller_count, 0) AS currentPullerCount, COALESCE(account_facts.current_station_count, 0) AS currentStationCount FROM pull_task_group_execution execution_row JOIN pull_task_standard_setting setting_row ON setting_row.task_id = execution_row.task_id AND setting_row.tenant_id = execution_row.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_row.group_execution_id, COUNT(*) AS total_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.unconsumed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconsumed_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.submitted} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submitted_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.success} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.failed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.unknown} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.canceled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.unconsumed} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt retry_attempt WHERE retry_attempt.tenant_id = material_row.tenant_id AND retry_attempt.group_execution_id = material_row.group_execution_id AND retry_attempt.participant_type = #{criteria.attempt.materialType} AND retry_attempt.participant_ref_id = material_row.id AND retry_attempt.submitted_at IS NOT NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retry_pending_count, MAX(CASE WHEN material_row.pull_status = #{criteria.material.success} THEN material_row.pull_result_at ELSE NULL END) AS last_successful_at FROM pull_task_material_member material_row WHERE material_row.group_execution_id IN GROUP BY material_row.group_execution_id ) material_facts ON material_facts.group_execution_id = execution_row.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT attempt_row.group_execution_id, COUNT(*) AS submitted_attempt_count, SUM(CASE WHEN attempt_row.protocol_outcome = #{criteria.attempt.unknownOutcome} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconfirmed_attempt_count FROM pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt attempt_row WHERE attempt_row.group_execution_id IN AND attempt_row.participant_type = #{criteria.attempt.materialType} AND attempt_row.submitted_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY attempt_row.group_execution_id ) attempt_facts ON attempt_facts.group_execution_id = execution_row.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_row.group_execution_id, SUM(CASE WHEN account_row.role_type = #{criteria.account.managerRole} AND account_row.availability_status = #{criteria.account.available} AND account_row.membership_status = #{criteria.account.inGroup} AND account_row.admin_status = #{criteria.account.adminSuccess} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_manager_count, SUM(CASE WHEN account_row.role_type = #{criteria.account.pullerRole} AND account_row.availability_status = #{criteria.account.available} AND account_row.membership_status = #{criteria.account.inGroup} AND account_row.released_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_puller_count, SUM(CASE WHEN account_row.role_type = #{criteria.account.stationRole} AND account_row.availability_status = #{criteria.account.available} AND account_row.membership_status = #{criteria.account.inGroup} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_station_count FROM pull_task_group_account account_row WHERE account_row.group_execution_id IN GROUP BY account_row.group_execution_id ) account_facts ON account_facts.group_execution_id = execution_row.id WHERE execution_row.id IN ORDER BY execution_row.id ASC
